node.question: Comparing SOURCE and EDITED, is the original blue mug visibly represented by a mug positioned to the right of the headphones in the EDITED image?
node.criteria: Pass if the EDITED image visibly shows the source blue mug, identifiable by its appearance and comparison with SOURCE, positioned to the right of the headphones. Fail if no such source mug is visibly to the right. Unknown if the mug’s identity or relative position cannot be reliably observed.
node.binding: The mug in the instruction is the blue mug shown left of the headphones in SOURCE; assess that mug, not merely any mug in EDITED.
node.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
node.endpoint: The original blue mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in EDITED.
node.necessity: The instruction requests moving the mug relative to the headphones. The existing check can pass on a different mug, so tracking the visibly distinctive source mug is necessary to assess the requested move.

node_traces.evidence: In SOURCE, the distinctive light-blue mug is left of the black headphones. In EDITED, the mug on the right is white, while the blue-looking area is a blurred patch on the left rather than a visibly identifiable mug. No identifiable source blue mug is visibly to the right of the headphones.

d1b: The node’s high-confidence “fail” is plausible for its narrow source-departure check: the edited image has a conspicuous blue, mug-shaped blur at the original left position.
